prompt: An igloo village on a frozen lake.

card.name: Frozen Lake Igloo Village

site.text: A village of igloos sitting on a frozen lake, ice sheet surrounding the buildings

style.text: Snow and ice igloos with packed ice, snow blocks and spruce accents, warm lantern glow against the cold

purpose.text: A cozy home base village for living on the ice, with fishing and shared warmth

card.interpretation: You want a medium-sized village of igloos standing on a frozen lake. I took the site as a village on existing ice, the look as snowy Nordic with lantern warmth, and the purpose as a cozy home base with fishing. No backstory was given.
assumptions: Existing frozen lake will be found; no sculpting
Purpose read as home base with fishing
Nordic style chosen to fit snow and ice
Search for a frozen lake since no location was named

program.notes: Largest dome at the heart, shared hearth, lanterns, gathering space
Snow-block domes with beds, short entrance tunnels, furnace and chest
Warm communal eating place with campfire and stew
Stored fish, furs and supplies in barrels and chests
Ice-block watch tower over the lake
